# mv: convert function with pointer first arg to method
mv F T.M
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

func F(t *T, n int) int { return t.X + n }

func G() int {
	var t T
	return F(&t, 1)
}
-- stderr --
x.go:9:10: invalid operation: cannot take address of t.M(1) (value of type int)
errors found after executing: mv F T.M
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,9 +2,9 @@

 type T struct{ X int }

-func F(t *T, n int) int { return t.X + n }
+func (t *T) M(n int) int { return t.X + n }

 func G() int {
 	var t T
-	return F(&t, 1)
+	return &t.M(1)
 }
